outcome: Types of arrhythmias (sinus tachycardia, sinus bradycardia)
cohort: All neonates admitted to the NICU at Inova Children's Hospital at Inova Fairfax Medical Campus between January 1, 2021 and April 1, 2021, totaling 201 neonates.
finding: Approximately 68% of neonates admitted to the NICU exhibited at least one arrhythmia, with 6.5% having clinically relevant arrhythmias, indicating a high burden of benign but a low burden of pathologic arrhythmias.
followup_time: Up to 195 days (median 16 days) from admission to hospital discharge.
